settings.label: No permadeath in Vostok zones
settings.description: Dying in Apartments, Terminal or Airfield works like dying anywhere else: you wake up at your shelter instead of losing every save.

settings.label: No permadeath on Hardcore
settings.description: On the hardest difficulty every map is permadeath. With this on, deaths there work like normal deaths too.

settings.label: When you die
settings.description: What you still have when you wake up at your shelter. You always come back at full health.

settings.label: Keep your gear when quitting outside a shelter
settings.description: Quitting to the menu or desktop away from a shelter normally deletes what you carry. With this on it's saved, and you continue from your shelter.
